high_level_description: This image is the cover of a Time magazine issue dated May 1 to May 8, 2017. The cover features a portrait of Jeff Bezos, the founder of Amazon, prominently displayed on an orange background with a red border. The title "TIME" is written in large white letters at the top of the cover. The main text on the cover reads "THE 100 MOST INFLUENTIAL PEOPLE," indicating that Jeff Bezos was one of the individuals recognized as highly influential by the publication.
